abstract: Ribosome biogenesis is an essential process in all cells across organisms, especially during development of the gonad. How ribosome biogenesis impacts gonad development remains to be understood. Work in zebrafish has identified distinct oocyte- and somatic cell-type ribosomal DNA (rDNA) loci, M rDNA and S rDNA, respectively, and it has been hypothesized that the M rDNA locus or the M ribosomal RNA (rRNA)-containing ribosome could function as the major female sex determinant. To better understand how the M and S rDNA loci are regulated during zebrafish gonadogenesis, we visualized M and S rRNA transcripts in vivo in developing bipotential gonads, ovaries, and testes. We find that oogonia and early spermatogonia contain M and S rRNA transcripts, while germ cells of the biopotential gonad contain M rRNA transcripts almost exclusively. We find that M rRNA transcription is preferentially maintained in differentiating prophase I oocytes. In contrast, M rRNA transcripts are not present in late spermatogonia, which instead exhibit exclusive S rRNA transcription prior to further differentiation where S rRNA transcription becomes progressively absent. We determine that M rRNA transcription initiation precedes and does not depend on the onset of meiosis. rRNA visualization in a female sex differentiation and ribosome biogenesis mutant, rbpms2, showed that ectopic S rRNA transcription may be disruptive to continued oogenesis, but this is not regulated by the DNA methyltransferases, Dnmt3bb.1, Dnmt3bb.2, and Dnmt3bb.3. Altogether, we find that transcription of M rRNA does not function as a female sex determinant in zebrafish gonadogenesis, though its preferential maintenance in oocytes may be essential to ribosome biogenesis, meiotic entry and progression, and female sex differentiation.

summary: In zebrafish gonads, M rRNA transcription is preferentially maintained in oocytes and precedes meiosis, but it does not act as a female sex determinant.
title: Female sex determination in zebrafish does not depend on M ribosomal RNA transcription
